notes: Spawn configurations for the zone cartography survey. Each config is a RULE,
not coordinates: tools/plan_cartography_runs_v1.py resolves it per map against
that map's terrain raster (authored start positions + buildable/metal cells).
The point of the matrix is that one canonical 1v1 only ever shows you one front.
Folding the map (adjacent), opening it up (three_way, four_corners) and inverting
it (center_vs_rim) is what exposes which ground is a lane, which is a shelf nobody
ever walks, and which middle is contested no matter who starts where.
Sim minutes are budget: ~28 min wall per 21 sim-min headless run on this machine.
Milestone frames are the Fibonacci minute ladder the profiler already uses.

configs.label: Mirror 1v1
configs.reveals: The canonical front. Comparable with the June 2026 baseline survey.

configs.label: Three-way FFA
configs.reveals: Contested middles and secondary lanes; which pair never meets.

configs.label: Folded 1v1
configs.reveals: Which ground becomes the front when the two starts are neighbours.

configs.label: Four corners
configs.reveals: Maximum pressure everywhere -- exposes ground the war NEVER uses.

configs.label: Centre vs rim
configs.reveals: Siege geometry: who owns the middle when someone starts in it.

configs.label: Wilds pressure
configs.reveals: Hazard territory: which ground the raptor pressure owns outright.

schedule.notes: Runner is resumable (-Resume skips runs whose raster already exists), so a night that ends early just continues next time.
